mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STORE ( store_id, producer_id, owner_user_id, store_name, description, thumbnail_url, status, is_active, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( SEQ_STORE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{producerId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{storeName}, #{description}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{status}, #{isActive}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT store_id AS storeId, producer_id AS producerId, owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, store_name AS storeName, description, thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, status, is_active AS isActive, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM STORE WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
